source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
As [Declare Battle Formations](vsdata:core-rule/combat-patrol.declare-battle-formations) begins, this model can join a **GUARDIAN DEFENDERS** unit of yours, unless a **SUPPORT WEAPON** model has already joined that unit. It then counts as one of that **GUARDIANS** unit's models until the battle ends, and the **Starting Strength** of that unit rises to include it.

This model cannot [embark](vsdata:core-rule/embarking) in a **TRANSPORT**, and no unit it has joined can either.

ability.timing: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

cannotEmbark.who: this model and any unit it is joined to
